source: Pakistan Railways official web app (www.pakrailways.gov.pk/train, "RABTA") public JSON: POST https://isapi.pakrailways.gov.pk/v1/ticket/trainInfo/trainInfoList {boardStationCode, arrivalStationCode, travelDate} then GET /ticket/trainInfo/stopTimeTable/<trainDirDay.id>. Both calls are made by the public page without a login (isToken:false in the site bundle).
publisher: Pakistan Railways (Ministry of Railways, Government of Pakistan)
licence: No licence or API terms published. Government work (Copyright Ordinance 1962); timetable times and station order are facts, cite the source. The API is an undocumented backend of the booking site: fetched once, ~1.5 s between requests; do not poll it.

field_notes.distance_km: cumulative distance from origin as given by the API
field_notes.running_state: raw runningState; the site appends ' (Stop)' to the station name when it is not '1' (meaning unclear: not stopping / stop suspended)
field_notes.name: from the pakrail.gov.pk train dropdown; null for 171UP/172DN and S2DN/S3UP/S4DN (not in that dropdown; S-series are Pind Dadan Khan / Malakwal / Lala Musa / Sargodha shuttles)
field_notes.our_stop_count: stop count of the same train in research/incoming/pakistan-railways-trains.json (pakinformation.com-based) for comparison
